Go Now! was made popular internationally later in 1964 when an English beat group from Birmingham named The Moody Blues recorded it, with Denny Laine on guitar and lead vocals. When Denny Laine first heard Bessie Banks's version, he immediately told the rest of the band that they needed to record the song.Go Now  is a song composed by Larry Banks and Milton Bennett.

Kitaen was married to Whitesnake lead singer David Coverdale from 1989–1991.… Read More. Julie E. Tawny Kitaen (born August 5, 1961) is an American actress and media personality. She had recurring parts on multiple television series such as Hercules: The Legendary Journeys and co-hosted America's Funniest People from 1992–1994.
